drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel, attached is our proposed draft for discussion. To move this toward prompt resolution, we have included a proposed settlement amount of $6,000,000 and straightforward payment mechanics. Please let us know your client’s comments, including any practical changes that would help finalize the agreement efficiently.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after this Agreement is fully executed, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement through the date of execution. Nothing in this Agreement releases claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, tax or financial advisers, immediate family, or as required by law, court order, or governmental process. A party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
